description: Figure: structural superposition quality, AlphaFold confidence, and conservation of the experimentally mapped eEF2/TRiC-binding patches
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
sup=pd.read_csv("superposition_6HB1A_vs_AFQ10498.csv")
cons=pd.read_csv("hgh1_interface_conservation.csv")
s1=[6,7,8,9,10]; s2=[215,216,217,218,219]; ct=list(range(303,311))

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13,9))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,2,height_ratios=[1,1,1.5],hspace=0.55,wspace=0.25)

# (a) deviation along chain
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
ax.plot(sup.sp_res, sup.dev_A, lw=0.9, color="#2b6cb0")
ax.axhline(1.67, ls="--", c="grey", lw=0.8)
for r,c,lab in [(s1,"#c53030","site 1"),(s2,"#d69e2e","site 2"),(ct,"#718096","control")]:
    ax.axvspan(min(r)-1.5,max(r)+1.5,color=c,alpha=0.35)
ax.set_xlabel("S. pombe hgh1 residue"); ax.set_ylabel("Ca deviation (A)")
ax.set_title("a  AlphaFold hgh1 (Q10498) superposed on Hgh1 crystal 6HB1 chain A: core RMSD 1.67 A over 297 pairs, TM-score 0.82", fontsize=10, loc="left")

# (b) pLDDT
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,:])
import itertools
# recompute pLDDT from file
b=[]; n=[]
for l in open("AF-Q10498.pdb"):
    if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA":
        n.append(int(l[22:26])); b.append(float(l[60:66]))
ax.plot(n,b,lw=0.9,color="#2f855a"); ax.axhline(70,ls="--",c="grey",lw=0.8)
for r,c in [(s1,"#c53030"),(s2,"#d69e2e"),(ct,"#718096")]:
    ax.axvspan(min(r)-1.5,max(r)+1.5,color=c,alpha=0.35)
ax.set_ylim(30,102); ax.set_xlabel("S. pombe hgh1 residue"); ax.set_ylabel("pLDDT")
ax.set_title("b  AlphaFold confidence: mean 94.2, only the acidic C-terminal tail (334-356) below 70", fontsize=10, loc="left")

# (c) patch identity across species
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,0])
cs=cons.sort_values("pct_id_vs_Sc",ascending=False)
y=np.arange(len(cs))
w=0.27
ax.barh(y-w, cs.site1_pid, w, color="#c53030", label="site 1 (Sc 7-11)")
ax.barh(y,   cs.site2_pid, w, color="#d69e2e", label="site 2 (Sc 236-240)")
ax.barh(y+w, cs.ctrl_pid,  w, color="#a0aec0", label="control (Sc 326-333)")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([s.replace(" f. sp. tritici","") for s in cs.species], fontsize=6)
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.set_xlabel("% identity to S. cerevisiae patch"); ax.legend(fontsize=7, loc="lower right")
ax.set_title("c  Conservation of the mapped eEF2/TRiC patches", fontsize=10, loc="left")
for lab in ax.get_yticklabels():
    if lab.get_text().startswith("Schizosaccharomyces pombe"): lab.set_color("#c53030"); lab.set_fontweight("bold")

# (d) sequence detail
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,1]); ax.axis("off")
sel=cons[cons.acc.isin(["P48362","Q10498","Q9BTY7","Q6CJW6","Q6C2J7","A0A8H5U6L6"])].copy()
order={"P48362":0,"Q10498":1,"Q6CJW6":2,"Q6C2J7":3,"A0A8H5U6L6":4,"Q9BTY7":5}
sel["o"]=sel.acc.map(order); sel=sel.sort_values("o")
txt="site 1 / site 2 / control patch sequences\n\n%-26s %-7s %-7s %-9s\n"%("species","site1","site2","control")
for _,r in sel.iterrows():
    txt+="%-26s %-7s %-7s %-9s\n"%(r.species[:26], r.site1_seq, r.site2_seq, r.ctrl_seq)
txt+="\nS. pombe equivalents: site1 = E6-L7-V8-G9-F10\n                      site2 = K215-N216-I217-S218-F219\n"
txt+="\nCentroid separation site1-site2:\n   S. cerevisiae crystal 45.6 A\n   S. pombe AlphaFold    46.6 A\n"
ax.text(0,1,txt,va="top",family="monospace",fontsize=8.5)
plt.show()
print(cons[cons.acc.isin(["P48362","Q10498","Q9BTY7"])][["species","pct_id_vs_Sc","site1_seq","site1_pid","site2_seq","site2_pid","ctrl_seq","ctrl_pid"]].to_string(index=False))
